key.name: engine
key.description: Type of wallpaper engine. Supported: "video" (Rexon video wallpaper host). Web/scene/application engines were removed — those types are rendered by the waywallen daemon on compositors that support wlr-layer-shell.

key.name: source
key.description: Path to scene.json, plugin .py, HTML file, or URL — depending on selected engine.

key.name: daemon-argv
key.description: Full command line of the wallpaper host process, written by Rexon when it hands a wallpaper over. The extension spawns it as is. Empty means Rexon has not written it yet (extension installed by an older version) - there is no fallback any more, so the extension logs an error and shows nothing until the extension is reinstalled from Rexon.

key.name: fps
key.description: Frames per second for the wallpaper renderer.
